name: v2.31.1
body:
## What's Changed
* Improve test coverage for `batch_utils.py` by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2437
* Refresh completions when a DDL statement starts with a comment by @goranai in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2439
* Don't flag a safe UPDATE as destructive when it starts with a comment by @Kernel-Hunter in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2440
* Reset completions for USE and connect statements that start with a comment by @Kernel-Hunter in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2441
* Update `setuptools` llm dependency to v84.2.1 by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2442
* Update `tox`, `virtualenv`, and `filelock` for `uv audit` by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2443
* fix: read password file and contributor/sponsor/tip files as UTF-8 by @pcbeingused333 in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2444
* Encode slashes in DSN usernames by @sxwangsxwang1 in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2446
* Prepare changelog for release v2.31.1 by @rolandwalker in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2447

## New Contributors
* @goranai made their first contribution in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2439
* @sxwangsxwang1 made their first contribution in https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/pull/2446

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/dbcli/mycli/compare/v2.31.0...v2.31.1
